description: General-purpose popover container with CSS Anchor Positioning. Wraps the native Popover API, binds an anchor element (appending to its anchor-name list), and re-asserts display:none under VB's cascade layers. Trigger via the standard popovertarget attribute. The host has no role: authors supply the semantics.

attributes.name: data-mode
attributes.description: Popover type: 'auto' (default, light-dismiss + Escape, closes other auto popovers), 'manual' (script-only), 'hint' (light-dismiss without closing open auto popovers; falls back to 'auto' where popover="hint" is unsupported). Hover opening is not wired (use interestfor or tool-tip). Changes after upgrade re-apply the popover attribute; an authored popover attribute wins at upgrade.

attributes.name: data-anchor
attributes.description: ID (or CSS selector) of the anchor element to position against. If omitted, the component uses the first element whose popovertarget points at this pop-over. Changes after upgrade re-wire the anchor.

attributes.name: data-position
attributes.description: Where to place the popover relative to the anchor; -start/-end are logical (mirror in RTL). Flips to the opposite side instead of overflowing the viewport. Default: 'bottom'.

attributes.name: data-offset
attributes.description: Gap between popover and anchor, mapped to --size-* tokens. Default: 'xs'.

attributes.name: data-anchor-name
attributes.description: Set by the runtime when an anchor is bound with CSS Anchor Positioning: the dashed-ident appended to the anchor's anchor-name and used as this host's position-anchor. Absent when there is no anchor or no anchor-positioning support.

events.name: pop-over:show
events.description: Fired (bubbles, composed) on beforetoggle as the popover opens, whether by popovertarget, show() or showPopover().

events.name: pop-over:hide
events.description: Fired (bubbles, composed) on beforetoggle as the popover closes, including light-dismiss and Escape.

properties.name: open
properties.description: Read-only. True while the popover is open (:popover-open).

methods.name: show()
methods.description: Open the popover (no-op if already open).

methods.name: hide()
methods.description: Close the popover (no-op if already closed).

methods.name: toggle()
methods.description: Open if closed, close if open.
